context_requirements: Expression of the drug's target integrin heterodimer (e.g., ITGA2B/ITGB3 for alphaIIb-beta3 antagonists) on the cell surface
Adhesion to an extracellular matrix ligand recognized by the targeted integrin
Active integrin-dependent signaling (FAK/SRC/MAPK) that can be inhibited
For alphaIIb-beta3-specific antagonists, platelet/megakaryocyte lineage is required; most adherent cell lines lack this heterodimer
falsifiers: No change in any of the nine cell lines at 6 h or 24 h for all tested drugs in the class
Strong, immediate (6 h) transcriptional changes in all nine lines, which would suggest a non-integrin off-target mechanism
A reproducible increase in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h
Line-to-line differences that do not track with integrin expression or adhesion status
